scares.description: A man bangs on the front window of the plane from the outside, after which it’s revealed the plane is actually a set.
The girl is suddenly grabbed by a plastic bag on the face while going through a rack of clothes.
A dog jumps at the window behind the girl and starts barking.
Someone suddenly runs across the room behind the plastic sheets.
Simon turns out and is struck by the killer.
A hammer smashes the glass as Amy leans in for a look.
A mannequin drops onto the table from above.
While running away from the killer, Amy runs into Trevor.
Toby is startled while driving, followed by a cut to Amy standing in the middle of the road.
